object: Russian infantry musket, pattern 1808, Tula 1811 museum reference

macro.scaleConfidence: low; not a measurement of the reference object
macro.coordinateConvention: +X toward muzzle; +Y upward; +Z right lock side; metres

visibleFeatures: muzzle rim with shallow dark recess

components.name: bands
